newsitem.title: CHINA: China sets April interest rate subsidy at 0.17 pct.
newsitem.headline: China sets April interest rate subsidy at 0.17 pct.

text.p: China's central bank, the People's Bank of China, set the interest rate subsidy for April at 0.17 percent, the Financial News said on Saturday.
The rate is down from the March subsidy of 0.94 percent.
The subsidy is paid on bank deposits of three years or more.
The subsidy, paid on fixed deposits as they fall due, is given on top of normal interest rates to attract long-term deposits during a period of high inflation.
But China stopped paying the subsidy on new deposits as of last April because inflation has been easing.
The subsidy was introduced in March 1994 and hit a record of 13.24 percent in December 1995.
